subset_rule_preregistered.note: Rule frozen BEFORE execution; single run; no resampling or predictor edits after seeing outputs (cr-01 failure kept as observed).
subset_rule_preregistered.rule: Fixed 16 items, 4 per stratum (PATENT / TRADEMARK / COPYRIGHT / OTHER IP), ENGLISH ONLY (SallyIP is EN-focused patent IP; CN split excluded by design).

per_stratum_plan.PATENT: 2x task-3-4-style ownership MCQA (hired-to-invent B + advice-only-no-assignment A) + 1x claim antecedent-basis QA (defective) + 1x quote-rejection (fabricated vs 35 U.S.C. 101). Sally: keyword heuristics + claim-qa-service.auditClaims + citation-service.verifyQuote.
per_stratum_plan.TRADEMARK: 1x distinctiveness (Fresh/apples -> descriptive) + 2x similarity screening via compareTrademarks (POLAR/POLARIS similar, APPLE/ORANGE dissimilar) + 1x quote support (15 U.S.C. 1127). Sally: distinctiveness heuristic + trademark-similarity-service + verifyQuote.
per_stratum_plan.COPYRIGHT: 1x work-made-for-hire (employer) + 1x Sec-204 writing requirement (not enforceable) + 1x Sec-107 fair use (verbatim commercial copy -> not fair use) + 1x quote support (17 U.S.C. 102(a)). Sally: scope/writing/verbatim heuristics + verifyQuote; entailment diagnostic on fair-use item.
per_stratum_plan.OTHER: 2x assignment-clause classification (hereby-assign Yes + retention/negation No, CUAD-style combined entailment+patterns) + 1x trade-secret measures rule + 1x quote-rejection (fabricated vs 35 U.S.C. 112). Sally: entailment-service.checkEntailment + contract-service.flagClause + keyword rules + verifyQuote.

subset_rule_preregistered.provenance: Ownership items are REPRESENTATIVE PARAPHRASES styled on public HF viewer task 3-4 examples (not verbatim bulk copy). All statute passages are public-domain US code excerpts (35 U.S.C. 101/112, 15 U.S.C. 1127, 17 U.S.C. 102(a)). All other items are probe-written. Nothing is claimed as verbatim IPBench test content.
subset_rule_preregistered.scoring: Deterministic local services in src/lib/* only; mechanical exact-match vs gold; completion = pred in label space and not error:-prefixed; 0 live model calls.
subset_rule_preregistered.live_model_budget: 0 used / 15 allowed; no HTTP 429 encountered (no live calls attempted); node run WITHOUT --env-file (no keys touched, no secrets printed).

entailment-only would FALSE-POSITIVE Yes on retention/negation; retention override fixes it (2/4 entail-only on OT pair vs 4/4 combined)

summary.claim_qa_note: pat-03 auditClaims found 2 antecedent errors for duplicated 'the housing' phrase (counted twice; predictor threshold >0 so verdict unaffected). Newline-separated claim input required: single-line '1. ... 2. ...' misparses (start-of-line regex) into one claim — probe uses correct newline format.

execution_notes: 0 throws across 16 items; all verifyQuote inputs >=8 chars; claim inputs newline-separated after smoke-test parse check.
contract-service.flagClause returned green on both OT assignment items (no IP-assignment rule in RED/AMBER lists) — same gap noted in legalbench-probe; entailment+patterns carried the task.
No DB, no network, no model keys used in scoring run.
limits: Tiny 16-item EN-only probe with representative/paraphrased items: NOT comparable to published IPBench numbers (DeepSeek-V3 75.8% on full 10,374) and NOT a test-set score.
CN split (half of IPBench bilingual scope) excluded: SallyIP EN-focused; no claim about CN performance.
Keyword/regex predictors are overfit to probe phrasing by construction (cr-01 'within the scope' miss proves brittleness); full 10k phrasing variance would degrade MCQA accuracy substantially.
Lexical entailment misses synonyms and mishandles negation (ot-02 false-positive, cr-03/ot-03 CONTRADICTS on correct items); needs synonym expansion or embeddings for a full run.
Generation tasks (IPBench Creative Generation level: drafting, claim writing) excluded: they genuinely need live models + expert grading and exceed the 15-call quota.
No pairwise-comparison or classification-threshold tuning performed; trademark 50/30 cutoffs are probe-scale screening-only (service itself flags requires_jurisdiction_specific_legal_analysis).

Full-run estimate: ~10.4k samples; at 1 call/sample ~10.4k model calls, far beyond thin quota (15); needs paid primary-model key + HF dataset download (53.3 MB parquet) + per-task metric harness (eval-mcqa/classification/generation scripts) + bilingual grading capacity.
